findings.why: A disclosure is present, but it sits at the end of the caption, likely below the 'See more' cut-off. ASCI asks for paid-partnership disclosure to be upfront and hard to miss. Acceptable if Meta's 'Paid partnership' label is also switched on.
findings.fix: Move '#Ad' to the start of the first line (e.g. '#Ad Boys: no face wash, still flawless. How?'), and turn on the Paid partnership label.

tone_read: This is a creator's own playful voice ('saviour', 'still flawless'), so it isn't held to Minimalist's brand tone. It makes no disease, acne-elimination or time-bound claim about the product.
language_read: The product is named as 'Minimalist Salicylic Acid Cleanser' without its concentration, which is acceptable in creator voice but loses the brand's signature number. No natural, chemical-free or unhedged efficacy wording appears.
